fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Stirling micro-CHP with thermal warm-up ODE
source: Walker (1980) Stirling Engines, Oxford; Organ (1992) Thermodynamics & Gas Dynamics of the Stirling Cycle Machine, Cambridge; Beale number correlation (West 1986, Principles & Applications of Stirling Engines); WhisperGen Mk5 / Microgen Stirling micro-CHP datasheets; Onovwiona & Ugursal (2006) Renew. Sustain. Energy Rev. 10:389; Conroy et al. (2014) Appl. Energy 122:194 (WhisperGen field trial)

P_e_rated_W.note: Rated electrical output ~1 kWe (WhisperGen Mk5 ~1 kWe; Microgen ~1 kWe)

T_hot_K.note: Heater-head (expansion space) gas temperature, 600 C, set by burner

T_cold_K.note: Cooler (compression space) temperature ~60 C, coupled to heating-circuit return water

beale_number.note: Beale number Bn=P/(p_mean*V_swept*f); West (1986) typical 0.11-0.15 for well-designed engines

V_swept_m3.note: Swept (displaced) volume of power piston, 100 cm3

freq_Hz.note: Engine cycle frequency (3000 rpm, grid-synchronous linear/kinematic)

eta_burner.note: Burner combustion efficiency (fuel LHV -> heat delivered to heater head + flue)

eta_flue_recovery.note: Fraction of flue-gas sensible heat recovered to water (condensing recuperator)

carnot_fraction.note: Fraction of Carnot efficiency achieved by the small indicated cycle (regenerator/dead-volume/hysteresis losses dominate at this scale); gives eta_ind~0.14 so eta_e~0.11, matching WhisperGen-class units; Walker (1980), Onovwiona & Ugursal (2006)

m_thermal_kg.note: Lumped thermal mass of heater head + engine block + water jacket

cp_thermal_J_kgK.note: Effective specific heat of lumped metal+water mass

hA_loss_W_K.note: Casing standby heat-loss conductance to ambient

Q_fuel_max_W.note: Max burner fuel input (LHV basis) at full fire, ~7 kW

cp_gas_J_kgK.note: Flue-gas mean specific heat at constant pressure (natural-gas combustion products, 25-200 C); Turns (2012) An Introduction to Combustion

cp_water_J_kgK.note: Liquid water specific heat at ~40 C; NIST/Cengel & Boles (2015) Thermodynamics, Table A-3
